mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return direction does not correlate with FEDFUNDS changes (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window, or the signal fails to produce positive returns in 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months but the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic expansion, which boosts corporate profits and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint growth of GDPC1 and INDPRO fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,500,000 units annually, it signals strong consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Housing starts exceed 1,500,000 units annually but the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return direction does not correlate with PAYEMS changes (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window, or the signal fails to produce positive returns in 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO < 95.0 index), manufacturing bottlenecks and reduced output lead to higher inflation and tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO falls below 95.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real GDP (GDPC1) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) indicates a strong economy with rising price pressures, which typically leads to a Fed response that causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of GDPC1 growth and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
